player_prompt.intro:
Moom ngi jottu {player_id} ci JoJoJoin, joxe ci tablo 5x5 benn ci selli yamale 0-24.
Ci njabootu, joxe nataal ci seli bopp, by example '[12]'.
TOOY ci ngi by joxe nataal neeni ci ndaw ci mbooleem — nataal neeni yu bari ci ndaw, ci diggante, walla ci melosuuf.
Ci jottu {player_id} ngi '{symbol}'; moom ngi jëfandikoo '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} du cell bu wóor. War na nekk diggante 0 ak 24.

outcome.win: Jëfandikukat bi {player_id} moo ci jël ndam!
